item.text: I found Thunderbird’s relevant preferences: `mail.quoteasblock` controls the blockquote-style indentation, and `mail.quoted_graphical` controls whether quote markers are shown as graphical quote styling instead of literal `>` characters. I’m going to persist those in `user.js` so Thunderbird keeps the behavior after restarts, and I’ll also set the account to compose HTML replies so the quoted text is not converted into literal plain-text chevrons.
The persistent profile override is in place. I’m restarting Thunderbird now so it reads the new quote-formatting preferences; after restart I’ll check that the values landed in `prefs.js`.
